content.seoTitle: Work Office Wall Art Prints | Chinese Ink Landscape Set of 3
content.metaDescription: Bring calm focus to your workspace with this stunning Chinese ink landscape set of 3 — misty navy mountains, pine trees & birds in classic brushwork style. Free UK shipping!
content.productDescription:
Bring a real sense of calm and focus to your desk space with this set of three work office wall art prints — a breathtaking Chinese ink-wash landscape that feels both timeless and completely on-trend. Each print carries soft grey mountains receding into mist, vivid deep navy and indigo watercolour washes pooling at the base, tall green pine trees standing quietly against a pale sky, and tiny silhouettes of birds in flight. In the central print, a lone figure drifts across still water in a small boat — a beautifully peaceful detail that draws you in every time you glance up from your screen.

Together, the three pieces form a panoramic scene that tells a story across the wall. The ink-wash technique gives the whole set that distinctive brushstroke energy — loose and expressive where the navy washes bleed outward, precise and delicate in the mountain ridgelines. If you want art that makes your office feel considered and genuinely inspiring rather than just decorated, this is it.

What's Included with Work Office Wall Art Chinese Ink Landscape | Deep Navy, Misty Mountains & Pine Trees | Set of 3

  • Set of 3 individual art prints, printed in the UK using fade-resistant pigment inks for lasting colour
  • Suitable for indoor use only
  • Framed and canvas-wrapped options arrive ready to hang — no hunting for frames that fit, no faff
  • Choose between unframed and framed options in multiple sizes and in Luster or Museum quality; also available in wrapped canvas size options

How to Style Work Office Wall Art in Your Space

I'd hang all three prints side by side in a horizontal row at natural eye level — whether you're seated at your desk or standing, that's roughly 145–150 cm to the centre of the prints. Keep the gaps between each piece even and fairly tight (around 3–5 cm) so the panoramic landscape reads as one connected scene rather than three separate pictures. The pale, near-white background of each print means they sit beautifully against white, warm off-white, or even a deep navy or slate wall — the contrast either way is gorgeous.

This set isn't just for a traditional office either. I think it works wonderfully in a home study, a creative studio, a boardroom feature wall, or a calm therapy or consultation room. The cool greys and deep navy tones pair really well with natural wood desks, dark metal shelving, and simple neutral furnishings — it grounds the space without cluttering it. If you're after more nature-inspired pieces to complete your workspace, have a browse through our nature wall art collection for complementary prints.

Choosing the Right Size and Style for Your Walls

With a set of three, the combined width matters as much as the individual print size. I'd measure your wall first and work backwards — if you have a generous stretch of wall (say, above a long desk or sideboard), go for the larger sizes so the landscape has real presence. In a smaller home office or study alcove, the mid-range sizes are just the right weight without overwhelming the room. The deep navy and grey tones mean this set suits both bright, airy spaces and cosier, darker rooms equally well.

For paper choice: if you want rich, deep colour saturation in those navy washes, Museum quality paper gives you the deepest tones and finest detail. Luster art paper is a brilliant all-rounder with a lovely subtle sheen that handles the grey ink gradients beautifully. If you prefer a frameless, contemporary look, the wrapped canvas option is a great shout — especially for a more relaxed or modern workspace. Scroll down to see how each size looks in your room before you decide.

aiItems.content:
What is work office wall art?

Work office wall art refers to art prints and wall pieces chosen specifically to enhance a professional workspace — whether that's a home office, studio, boardroom, or corporate environment. The right artwork can make a workspace feel calmer, more focused, and genuinely inspiring rather than purely functional. Sets of prints, like this Chinese ink-wash landscape trio, are a popular choice because they create a cohesive focal point on the wall without requiring lots of individual styling decisions. Good office wall art tends to favour considered colour palettes — cool neutrals, deep blues, muted greens — that support concentration and look polished throughout the working day.

How to Hang Work Office Wall Art as a Set of 3

1. Measure your wall space first: Before you order, measure the width of the wall or area you have in mind. For a set of 3, add the combined print widths plus your preferred gap (3–5 cm between each) to get the total spread — this helps you choose the right size confidently.

2. Find your hanging height: Aim for the centre of the prints to sit at roughly 145–150 cm from the floor — this is comfortable whether you're seated at a desk or standing. If hanging above a desk or sideboard, leave around 15–20 cm of clear space between the furniture top and the bottom of the prints.

3. Map it out before you hammer: Cut three pieces of paper to the print sizes and blu-tack them to the wall first. Step back and check the arrangement feels balanced and that the gaps are even. Adjust before committing to any hooks or nails.

4. Hang left to right: Start with the leftmost print, use a spirit level, then work across. Keep your gap measurement consistent with a small piece of card or a ruler as a spacer between each piece.

5. Step back and enjoy: Once all three are up, check from the doorway or from your desk chair that the panoramic scene reads naturally across all three prints. Make tiny adjustments if needed — it's worth taking a moment to get it just right.

Choosing Your Print Format — Which Option Is Right for You?

Unframed Print — The art print on its own, ready for you to frame in your own choice of frame. Great if you already have frames you love or want to match existing décor exactly. Available on Luster art paper (lovely subtle sheen, excellent colour) or Museum quality paper (maximum depth and detail in the ink washes and navy tones).

Framed Print — Arrives ready to hang straight out of the packaging — no extra shopping, no measuring for frames. A brilliant time-saver and the most popular option for office spaces where you want everything to look sharp and finished from day one. Available in multiple sizes on Luster or Museum quality paper.

Wrapped Canvas — Printed directly onto canvas and stretched over a wooden frame — no glass, no glare, and a contemporary gallery feel. Particularly good in modern or minimalist workspaces. Arrives ready to hang and is available in a range of sizes.

Paper Choice: Luster vs Museum Quality — Luster art paper has a semi-gloss finish that handles the grey ink gradients and deep navy washes really well — great for most rooms and lighting conditions. Museum quality paper offers the finest tonal range and the richest colour depth, ideal if you want the most faithful reproduction of the ink-wash detail in this landscape.
